THIS STUDY WILL ELUCIDATE THE LINKS BETWEEN HABS AND HUMAN WELL-BEING, AND INVESTIGATE HOW AND WHY A COMMUNITY TAKES ACTION BASED ON DATA ABOUT THOSE LINKS.
